title: [DEV] Autosens is shown on Overview even if disabled
symptom: Autosens data is always drawn on the Overview screen as 'active' even when autosens is disabled (isAutosensModeEnabled() returns false). The icon with percentage value is shown even when autosens is not enabled.
cause: The condition in the code that determines when to show the Autosens icon is erroneous; it draws the icon even when isAutosensModeEnabled() returns false.
fix: The issue was resolved in a commit (0ef3d9b3757cc3b983132cae832d04cb51180395) that corrected the condition so the icon is only shown when autosens is enabled.
